Decks, Fences, Gates & Railings

All services

Custom Outdoor Structures

Your outdoor space is an extension of your home. Whether you're looking for a new deck to entertain on, a privacy fence, a secure gate, or sturdy railings, I build structures that are as beautiful as they are durable.

Prince Rupert's coastal climate demands materials and construction methods that can handle moisture, wind, and seasonal changes. I select high-quality materials — cedar is a favourite for its natural beauty and weather resistance — and build with techniques that ensure longevity.

What I Offer

  • Custom deck design and construction
  • Cedar and pressure-treated wood fencing
  • Driveway and garden gates
  • Deck and stair railings
  • Deck repairs and resurfacing
  • Pergolas and shade structures

My Approach

Every outdoor project starts with understanding how you want to use the space. I consider the layout of your property, sun exposure, views, and privacy needs. I work closely with you throughout the design and build process, ensuring the final result matches your vision and stands up to the elements for years to come.
